entities.name: Kurkesh
entities.description: Vengeful ogre spirit infesting ancient Onakke ruins on Shandalar, possibly once a powerful artificer.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: Ancient civilization of Ogres said to be masters of dark arts and artifice.

events.summary: Travelers who pilfer Onakke ruins meet their end at the hands of Kurkesh.
events.quote: More than one traveler daring enough to pilfer Onakke ruins met their end at this vengeful spirit's hands
